plugins.name: issue-flow
plugins.description: From request to merge request through an issue that holds the plan and the roadmap that executes it; for large developments, a project roadmap split into issues run in waves, with the work that can be parallelized handed to several agents, each in its own git worktree; and, before all that, the next steps proposed from the project's documentation. Works on GitLab (glab) and GitHub (gh).
